meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Dark spots aur dullness ke liye **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** meri best overall pick hai—beginner-friendly, stable vitamin C formula, aur usually easily available. Iske saath **SPF 50 sunscreen daily** zaroor lagayein, warna pigmentation wapas badh sakti hai.[1][4][8]

### Skin type ke hisaab se picks

- **Beginner / sensitive skin:** **Foxtale 10% Vitamin C-Glutathione** ya **Dr. Sheth’s Ceramide & 10% Vitamin C Ampoule**—gentler options.[2][10]
- **Oily ya acne-prone skin:** **The Derma Co 10% Vitamin C + 5% Niacinamide** ya **Deconstruct 10% Vitamin C**.[2][9]
- **Stubborn dark spots, experienced users:** **Plum 15% Vitamin C** ya **Minimalist 16% Vitamin C**; high-strength serum irritation de sakta hai, isliye dheere start karein.[1][8]
- **Budget option:** **Garnier Vitamin C + 2% Niacinamide serum**—isme 0.5% salicylic acid bhi hai, isliye very sensitive/dry skin par caution.[1][4]

### Kaise use karein

1. Morning mein clean, dry face par 2–3 drops lagayein.
2. Pehle 2 weeks alternate days use karein; irritation na ho to daily.
3. Moisturiser ke baad **broad-spectrum SPF 50** lagayein.
4. Same routine mein initially retinol, AHA/BHA ya strong exfoliants ke saath combine na karein.
5. Patch test karein; burning, rash ya persistent redness ho to band kar dein.

Agar dark spots 8–12 weeks mein improve na hon, rapidly badh rahe hon, ya melasma jaisa pattern ho, dermatologist se consult karein.
